content.user_title: Build disciplined simulated BTC trade plans
content.value_statement: Simulated trading agents need consistent rules for turning market observations into documented decisions. This skill applies ICT/SMC structure, entry criteria, and risk limits to BTC/USDT backtesting workflows.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes BTC/USDT with a 4H directional bias and 15-minute entry structure.
Defines trade, watch, note, and no-action decisions using explicit confluence criteria.
Documents liquidity sweeps, change of character, fair value gaps, and order blocks.
Builds simulated orders with entries, stops, targets, validity windows, and position sizing guidance.
Enforces a documented maximum of one concurrent order and 2% risk per trade.
Sets price alarms and records setup reasoning for later review.
limitations: It is designed for Alpha Harness backtesting and simulated BTC/USDT trading only.
It does not guarantee profitable trades or predict future prices.
It relies on the harness to provide accurate closed-candle market data and enforce order constraints.
It does not cover live broker execution, taxes, portfolio allocation, or financial advice.

use_cases.title: Practice structured backtesting
use_cases.description: Apply repeatable ICT/SMC rules to simulated BTC/USDT sessions and review each recorded decision.

use_cases.title: Build an auditable trading agent
use_cases.description: Require a simulated agent to record its bias, entry logic, risk, and targets before placing an order.

use_cases.title: Review strategy discipline
use_cases.description: Compare watch and trade decisions against fixed confluence and risk requirements after a backtest.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simulated session
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the SMC Harness workflow to inspect the current BTC/USDT simulation state. State whether the next action is trade, watch, note, or no action.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a potential entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze BTC/USDT using the 4H bias and 15-minute structure. Check for a liquidity sweep, change of character, and FVG or order block. Create a watch setup if confirmation is incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Construct a risk-controlled setup
prompt_templates.prompt: If all SMC confluences are present in the simulation, create a BTC/USDT trade setup. Include entry, stop, target, R:R, position size, validity window, and reasoning. Respect the 2% risk limit.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an existing order
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the active simulated BTC/USDT order against its original thesis. Check structure, liquidity, invalidation, and order limits. Recommend hold, cancel, watch, or note with concise reasoning.

output_examples.input: Assess a possible long after a sell-side liquidity sweep.
output: 4H bias: bullish while price remains in the discount area.
15-minute sweep: confirmed below the prior swing low.
Decision: watch until a bullish change of character and FVG entry form.

output_examples.input: Create a simulated trade after full bullish confirmation.
output: Decision: trade after aligned 4H bias, liquidity sweep, 15-minute change of character, and bullish FVG.
Risk plan: stop below the swept low and target opposing liquidity with at least 2:1 R:R.
Record the setup reasoning before placing one simulated order.

output_examples.output: Decision: no trade. A bullish 15-minute signal conflicts with the bearish 4H bias, so the workflow treats it as a possible counter-trend bounce and waits for alignment.

best_practices: Use only closed candles available in the simulation when forming a market view.
Record the HTF bias, liquidity event, entry trigger, stop, target, and R:R for every setup.
Choose watch or no action when the required confluences or minimum 2:1 R:R are absent.
anti_patterns: Do not place a simulated order before creating and documenting its setup.
Do not trade against the 4H bias solely because of a short-term signal.
Do not open another order while an active order already exists.

faq.question: Does this skill place live trades?
faq.answer: No. It is written for simulated Alpha Harness backtesting workflows.

faq.question: Which market does it cover?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is limited to BTC/USDT.

faq.question: Which timeframes does it use?
faq.answer: It uses a 4H timeframe for bias and a 15-minute timeframe for entry timing.

faq.question: What confirms an entry?
faq.answer: The workflow looks for a liquidity sweep, change of character, and an FVG or order block within the higher-timeframe context.

faq.question: What risk limit does it use?
faq.answer: The methodology specifies a maximum risk of 2% of the simulated balance per trade.

faq.question: Can it guarantee profitable results?
faq.answer: No. It provides a decision framework and does not guarantee market outcomes.
